subject.title: Gateway should expose HTTP REST endpoints for common queries

question: Should OpenClaw expose read-only session list/detail data through the existing default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin, through new dedicated REST GET endpoints, or keep that data on WebSocket/CLI surfaces for now?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but exposing session data over HTTP changes a security-sensitive operator API boundary and creates a public integration contract.

options.title: Extend admin HTTP RPC allowlist
options.body: Add read-only session query methods to the existing default-off trusted-operator plugin with docs and route/allowlist tests.

options.title: Add dedicated REST endpoints
options.body: Create thin authenticated GET routes for session and agent queries if maintainers want REST semantics rather than JSON-RPC.

options.title: Defer HTTP session exposure
options.body: Keep session list/detail access on WebSocket and CLI until maintainers are ready to own the broader HTTP contract.

recommendation.title: Extend admin HTTP RPC allowlist
recommendation.body: Add read-only session query methods to the existing default-off trusted-operator plugin with docs and route/allowlist tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is tied to the merged admin HTTP RPC hardening/docs and is the strongest current-history owner for the privileged HTTP boundary.
